name: shared-axis-y
title: Shared Axis Y
description: A per-word hard-cut staircase: the old phrase snaps off word by word, then the new phrase snaps on word by word, with no fade or motion. A sharp editorial swap.
useWhen: Swapping two related phrases (before/after, old/new, step N to step N+1) in a slide-deck style cut.
You want a crisp, confident replacement with no blur or scale.
avoidWhen: The text only needs to come in, with nothing going out: use short-slide-down or staggered-fade-up.
You want a depth or focus shift between the two phrases: use shared-axis-z.
The swap should feel playful or bouncy: use spring-scale-in.
author: Remocn
